title: Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa (Theme 15: Maadili ya kitaifa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the kind of speech (statement, question, command), applies its rule, and moves person, tense, time and place in both directions.
contexts: national values (maadili ya kitaifa): a speech by a leader reported

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Rais alisema kwamba wangedumisha amani" and one reported command.

misconceptions.ask: Haya ni maelezo, swali au amri?
misconceptions.repair: Amri katika usemi wa taarifa hutumia hali ya kuagiza: aliniambia nifungue.
Katika usemi wa taarifa, wakati husogea nyuma: alikuwa akiumwa.
Usemi halisi hurudisha maneno ya msemaji kama alivyoyasema: "Nitakuja."

misconceptions.ask: Kiulizi ni sehemu ya maneno ya msemaji?
misconceptions.repair: Koma kabla ya alama za mtajo, herufi kubwa ndani, na alama ya mwisho ndani.

checks.question: Badilisha kuwa usemi halisi: Amina alisema kwamba alikuwa amechoka.
